weather.typical: Cold North Cascades alpine; afternoon clouds and showers common
weather.probability: Afternoon thunderstorms common in summer; the couloir acts as a funnel for both rockfall and lightning

seasonal_hazards.exposure: Moderate - loose rock and scree in the couloir create rockfall/rock-knock-down risk between party members, with a short technical section near the summit block adding fall exposure, consistent with the loose-rock warnings

avalanche.zone: N/A - non-glaciated summer route (early-season wet-snow sluffing possible in the couloir but outside formal NWAC avalanche-season coverage)

seasonal_hazards.crevasses: N/A - route is snow/scree/rock with no documented glacier crossing
